description.value: Chun Fun How is a Taiwanese bubble tea brand with three Greater Vancouver locations, founded on the heritage and entrepreneurial spirit of its founder's father in Taiwan. The Kingsway location offers an extensive menu spanning osmanthus milk teas, purple yam fresh milk green teas, aloe vera fruit teas, and seasonal specials rooted in authentic Taiwanese ingredients. The brand also offers catering via a 3-litre party box format and free everyday delivery, making it a versatile refreshment stop.
